invoices_receiver_check.name: invoices_receiver_check
invoices_receiver_check.value: "invoices"."receiver_doc_type" in ('CF', 'DNI', 'CUIT') and ("invoices"."receiver_doc_type" = 'CF' or "invoices"."receiver_doc_number" is not null)

order_delivery_point_check.name: order_delivery_point_check
order_delivery_point_check.value: ("order_delivery"."lat" is null and "order_delivery"."lng" is null) or ("order_delivery"."lat" between -90 and 90 and "order_delivery"."lng" between -180 and 180)

variant_shipping_values_check.name: variant_shipping_values_check
variant_shipping_values_check.value: ("variant_shipping"."weight_grams" is null or "variant_shipping"."weight_grams" > 0) and ("variant_shipping"."length_cm" is null or "variant_shipping"."length_cm" > 0) and ("variant_shipping"."width_cm" is null or "variant_shipping"."width_cm" > 0) and ("variant_shipping"."height_cm" is null or "variant_shipping"."height_cm" > 0)
